biography.bio:
Designer, engineer and quiet philosopher - he built half of the team's gear and keeps the other half running.

Masks: Lifter, Grasshopper, New Lifter (wearing Lifter).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.Kzh2xqUSH5coi1JY]{Dynamo}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.mfzWIMFQ9uPRIjwQ]{Dynamo Assault Cart}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.8FDLRn28bXtxfpx5]{Rescue Mission}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.LXBXFCtqz2ijcQVm]{Rhino ATV}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Throws out an anti-gravity field that lifts people and cargo clean off the ground.

Bruce Sato's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the target's Toughness; a hit leaves it floating, Immobilized until the end of its next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Boosts the wearer's legs for enormous leaps.

Bruce Sato's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Leap: +30 ft Ground and an Edge on Athletics until the end of the turn. Clearing obstacles on the map is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
By day you have an ordinary life, and you work hard to keep it. Your Cover starts at 5. While it holds and you wear no mask, your Deception Tests have Edge. When the GM decides you slipped - seen unmasking, a vehicle followed home - you lose 1 Cover; at 0 your identity is blown. Once per mission, lying low restores 1.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

steps.message: Cover blown - V.E.N.O.M. knows who this agent really is.

steps.text: {name} lies low and shores up their cover.

automation.notes:
Pool: Cover, 5. Automatic: Deception Tests have Edge while Cover is above 0 and you wear no mask. Use buttons: lose 1 Cover (a chat warning when it reaches 0), and once per mission restore 1.

Left to the table: when the cover slips.

system.description:
You build and maintain the team's gear. Technology Tests have Edge, and once per scene you can patch up a damaged vehicle or piece of kit in the field. You can also do the lab work that rebonds a mask.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

rules.label: Field Repair (2 Health to the target)

automation.notes:
Automatic: Technology Tests have Edge. Use button: once per scene, the target regains 2 Health.

Left to the table: the mask lab work (the GM presses Rebond on the mask sheet afterwards).

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.

system.description:
The upgraded Lifter: its anti-gravity field, plus a holographic double.

Bruce Sato's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).
